name: ajuster rendez vous pris par partenaire
script:
user = "economiqaquasolutions23@gmail.com"

last_list = frappe.get_all(
    "Liste Appelle Entretien",
    fields=["name", "creation"],
    order_by="creation desc",
    limit=10
)

if not last_list:
    frappe.throw("Aucune Liste Appelle Entretien trouvée")

clients_T=[]
liste_appel = last_list[0].name
for ilist in last_list:
    liste_appel=ilist['name']
    clients = frappe.get_all(
        "Appelle Client",
        filters={"parent": liste_appel, "parenttype": "Liste Appelle Entretien"},
        pluck="client"
    )
    clients_T.extend(clients)

print(clients_T)
print(len(clients_T))
one_week_ago = frappe.utils.add_to_date(
    frappe.utils.now_datetime(),
    days=-7
)

tasks = frappe.get_all(
    "Tache de travail",
    filters={
        "owner": user,
        "creation": [">=", one_week_ago],
        "status": ["not in", ["Completed", "Cancelled"]]
    },
    fields=["name", "creation",'custom_client', "custom_choix_du_staff", "modified", "owner"],
    order_by="creation desc"
)
# Couleur (tâches ouvertes) : client créé par le partenaire -> cyan,
# sinon couleur par employé. Aligné sur compute_tache_color (api.py).
STAFF_COLORS = {
    "HR-EMP-00001": "#449CF0", "HR-EMP-00002": "#ECAD4B", "HR-EMP-00003": "#AA00AA",
    "HR-EMP-00004": "#761ACB", "HR-EMP-00005": "#CB2929", "HR-EMP-00006": "#ED6396",
    "HR-EMP-00007": "#888c89", "HR-EMP-00008": "#37fab2", "HR-EMP-00009": "#e6f542",
}
for task in tasks:
    cust = task.get("custom_client")
    by_partner = bool(cust) and frappe.db.get_value("Customer", cust, "owner") == user
    if by_partner:
        col = "#29def2"
    else:
        col = STAFF_COLORS.get(task.get("custom_choix_du_staff"), "#888c89")
    frappe.db.set_value("Tache de travail", task["name"], "color", col, update_modified=False)
    print(task["name"], col)

draft_lists = frappe.get_all(
    "Liste Appelle Entretien",
    filters={"docstatus": 0},
    pluck="name"
)

total = 0
for name in draft_lists:
    doc = frappe.get_doc("Liste Appelle Entretien", name)
    if int(doc.nb_appels_restant or 0) == 0:
        doc.submit()
        
    total = total + int(doc.nb_appels_restant or 0)
print(total)
doc=frappe.get_doc('Appel journalier','onaropc6oc')
now = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
hour = now.hour
today = frappe.utils.getdate(now)
CHILD_TABLE_FIELD = "stats_journaliere"
row_today = None
for r in doc.get(CHILD_TABLE_FIELD) or []:
    if frappe.utils.getdate(r.date) == today:
        row_today = r
        break
if not row_today:
    row_today = doc.append(CHILD_TABLE_FIELD, {})
    row_today.date = today

# 4) Matin / Soir
if hour >= 19:
    row_today.soir = total
else:
    row_today.matin = total

# 5) Calcul nombre appels
matin = row_today.matin or 0
soir = row_today.soir or 0
row_today.nombre_appels = matin - soir

doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.db.commit()
